run_mul_benchmark: run the mul benchmark that calls py_binding.int_mul 10 million times
run_noop_benchmark: run the noop benchmark that calls py_binding.no_op 100 million times
run_wrapped_noop_benchmark: run the wrapped_noop benchmark that wraps py_binding.no_op in a lambda and calls it 100 million times
run_default_benchmark: run the default mul benchmark by executing the script without arguments
run_cli_benchmark: run a specific benchmark by passing noop or wrapped_noop as the first command-line argument
